component: Qwen decoder layer 1 prime-hashed PLE residual contribution

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

conditions.reference: Pinned canonical Qwen4ExpTextPLELayer with exact BF16 key/value projection and convolution weights, exact FP32 norm weights, exact hash constants, and independent selected-row NVFP4 checkpoint decoding. Reference cache has three states for decoder layer 1.
conditions.native: b12x mapped-host ple_embedding, prepared BF16 projections, captured canonical norm and BF16 gate expressions, b12x raw short convolution with dilation3 and captured BF16 residual addition; CUDA graphs launched through PreparedGraphBundle and Rust GraphReplayWorker.

acceptance.allocator: allocation.all.allocated unchanged across each native graph replay
acceptance.zero_active: output exactly zero; all persistent convolution slots bitwise unchanged
acceptance.lifetime: worker.close before graph.reset; mapped table released by owner lifetime so unconfirmed native drain retains storage

coverage: EOS inside prefill and at request boundaries
two-token accepted history supplied in fixed GPU metadata
shared CUDA graph memory pool with persistent exported buffers
full table byte layout and exact selected embeddings
CPU bounded plane copies crossing65536-row boundary
host memory capacity rejection before allocation
mapped storage cleanup after checkpoint read failure
integration_requirement: The complete model graph gathers committed_history[B,2] from persistent per-request GPU token history before PLE lookup and updates it after token consumption. The PLE adapter reads these rows and mutates only its convolution state pool.
